name: Broadnet SMS Services: Orders, OTP, Login & Phone Number Access
author: rabihz

sections.description:
Boost your WooCommerce store with Broadnet SMS Services, a complete solution for secure communication and customer engagement. This plugin integrates seamlessly to deliver instant SMS notifications and authentication features:
1. Order Notifications – Keep customers updated with order confirmations, shipping progress, and delivery alerts.
2. OTP Verification – Add strong security with one-time passwords for checkout, registration, and sensitive actions.
3. Login Alerts – Notify users instantly about logins, password resets, and account activity.
4. Login by Phone Number – Allow customers to access their accounts using their mobile number, simplifying the login process and reducing password fatigue.

With Broadnet’s trusted SMS gateway, you can improve customer trust, streamline authentication, and provide a smoother shopping experience.

Features

OTP Authentication

  • Login with Mobile Number & OTP
  • Registration with Mobile OTP Verification
  • Password Reset using OTP
  • Secure OTP Authentication
  • Configurable OTP Expiry
  • Resend OTP Timer
  • Maximum OTP Attempts
  • Rate Limiting Protection

WooCommerce Order SMS

  • Pending Order SMS
  • Processing Order SMS
  • On Hold Order SMS
  • Completed Order SMS
  • Cancelled Order SMS
  • Refunded Order SMS

SMS Gateway

  • Custom SMS API Support
  • Sender ID Configuration
  • API Access Key Configuration
  • Test SMS Functionality

SMS Templates

  • Login OTP SMS
  • Registration OTP SMS
  • Password Reset OTP SMS
  • Order Status SMS
  • Dynamic Placeholders

Security

  • OTP Hashing
  • Nonce Validation
  • Secure AJAX Requests
  • Session Verification
  • OTP Expiry
  • Rate Limiting
  • Maximum Verification Attempts
  • Phone Number Validation

Support

If you experience any issues, please collect the following information before requesting support:

  • WordPress Version
  • WooCommerce Version
  • PHP Version
  • Plugin Version
  • Debug Log
  • SMS API Response
  • Steps to Reproduce

Support requests can be submitted through the WordPress.org support forum.

Privacy

This plugin communicates with your configured SMS gateway to deliver SMS messages.

Customer phone numbers are sent only to the configured SMS provider for message delivery.

The plugin does not collect, store, or transmit personal data to any third-party service other than the configured SMS gateway.

Credits

Developed and maintained by BroadNET.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP file through Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Click Install Now.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  5. Navigate to BroadNET SMS OTP Authentication settings.
  6. Configure your SMS Gateway credentials.
  7. Save the settings.
  8. Enable the required OTP features.
  9. Configure SMS templates.
  10. Test the SMS gateway before going live.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

Can customers log in using Mobile OTP?

Yes.

Does it support Registration with OTP?

Yes.

Does it support Password Reset using OTP?

Yes.

Does it still send WooCommerce Order Status SMS?

Yes. Existing Order SMS functionality remains fully supported.

Can I customize SMS templates?

Yes. Every SMS template can be customized from the plugin settings.

Which SMS Gateway is supported?

The plugin works with configurable SMS gateways using API credentials.
